name: Miyu
source:
A classmate gal who works as a starlight model and is also popular as an influencer.
She works as a magical girl along with Chika and Mei. She is good at bullying enemies with restraint techniques.
She has a strong-willed personality, and she looks down on the main character. On the other hand, Chika and Mei are important to her as her best friends
